import requests

url = "https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P51795.json"
response = requests.get(url)
if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    primary_accession = data.get("primaryAccession")
    uniProtkbId = data.get("uniProtkbId")
    sequence_info = data.get("sequence", {})
    length = sequence_info.get("length")
    mol_weight = sequence_info.get("molWeight")
    print(f"Accession: {primary_accession}")
    print(f"ID: {uniProtkbId}")
    print(f"Length: {length}")
    print(f"Molecular weight: {mol_weight}")
    
    # Check if there are isoforms
    comments = data.get("comments", [])
    for c in comments:
        if c.get("commentType") == "ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS":
            print("Isoforms info:")
            for iso in c.get("isoforms", []):
                print(iso)
else:
    print(f"Error: {response.status_code}")
